summary: Iteration 3 tested the Live Console, header counters, Equipa, Configurações and the download toast, plus regressions. Backend: the full pytest suite passes 37/37 (including the new test_iteration3_console.py). In one parallel run my new test had a race on the shared 'active' counter. I fixed the test, and it now passes serially. Frontend (Playwright, fake getDisplayMedia and a simulated python-socketio android device) works: sidebar order is correct; counters NOVOS/ATIVAS/ONLINE update live (0/0/0 -> 1/0/1 on CONECTAR -> 1/1/1 after accept); console-empty and console-placeholder texts are correct; the pending device appears instantly with Atribuir/Atender eu/Descartar; accept shows a 1280x720 video at 10 fps with rtc 'connected'; nav buttons are disabled for browser clients ('Ligado pelo navegador: só visualização'). For the android sim, all 9 nav buttons and text-send reach the device with the correct payloads: X=270,Y=600 at 1080x2400 gives tap x=0.25,y=0.25; up/down are scroll dy -1/1; long is right_click; left/right are swipes; recents and text work. Privacy on shows public-privacy-overlay and off removes it; the guided message reaches the client chat; the Logs tab lists commands and messages; the A11y tab renders; end removes the device from the list. Equipa create/edit/password/activity/delete all work. Technicians are redirected away from /crm/equipa and /crm/configuracoes. Configurações has only the Sistema and Auditoria tabs, with the repo and URLs shown. The public download button shows the 'A aplicação está a ser preparada' toast and stays on the page. Dashboard, Atendimentos, Dispositivos, Links and Viewer still render. TWO SPEC DEVIATIONS: (1) login lands on /crm (Dashboard), not /crm/consola; (2) 'Atender eu' inside the console navigates away to /crm/atendimentos/<id>.

minor.issue: Sessions whose device went offline (client closed the tab) stay 'assigned' or 'active' forever. They keep appearing in 'Aparelhos ligados' (grey dot) and are counted in NOVOS/ATIVAS, and the admin shows as 'Ocupado'. Consider auto-ending or expiring them after N minutes offline, or hiding offline ones from the console list.

ui_bugs.issue: After login the app navigates to '/crm' (Dashboard) instead of '/crm/consola'. Both nav('/crm') on line 30 and <Navigate to='/crm'> on line 18 need to point to '/crm/consola'. The App.js index route is also Dashboard.

'Atender eu' in the console always calls nav(`/crm/atendimentos/${id}`), so the user leaves the Consola ao Vivo. To use console-accept-btn they must go back to the Consola and select the device again. Add a prop (e.g. stayOnTake or onTaken) so the console keeps the selection, then shows Aceitar/Rejeitar in the centre. Also, nav() runs even when the take request failed.

integration_issues.issue: Carried over: ConnectPage calls a.start(""), so browser clients show as 'Linux · Chrome' and Viewer shows 'Cliente: Não indicado'.

issues: The device list card has min-h-[70vh] even when empty, so the viewer is pushed far below the fold. Header counters are hidden below the md breakpoint.
Before a session is selected, the coordinates label shows the default 1080x1920, which can be misleading.

action_items: Make the post-login landing /crm/consola (Login.jsx nav + Navigate; optionally the index route).
In LiveConsole, 'Atender eu' must stay on the console, keep the device selected and show console-accept-btn. Do not navigate when the take request fails.
Optional: handle stale sessions whose devices are offline in the console list and counters.
Optional: client name input on the public page.
critical_code_review_comments: SessionActions 'take' navigates unconditionally after act(), which swallows errors, so the user is sent to the Viewer even on failure.
LiveConsole reloads the whole session list on every queue:changed, device:online and device:offline event. This is fine at the current scale.

Counters re-fetch the full /dashboard (including 7 count queries for the chart and cleanup_retention) on every socket event. Consider a light /counters endpoint, because cleanup_retention runs on every header refresh.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (2 spec deviations: login landing, Atender eu navigation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login selectors: crm-login-email-input, crm-login-password-input, crm-login-submit-btn. Console flow: crm-nav-console -> console-device-<sid> -> take-btn-<sid> (currently navigates to the Viewer, so go back to the console and reselect) -> console-accept-btn. For android control from the UI, run `python /app/backend/tests/sim_android_device.py 280 &`. It prints the session_id to /tmp/sim_dev.log, auto-consents control on session:started, and logs every received remote:command. Run the full suite with `cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest -q` (~3 min). The full suite is mostly sequential across 2 workers, so absolute counter assertions are racy.
